units.source_text: 父亲的病在这样的状态下持续了一个多星期。

en.t: Father's illness continued in this state for more than a week.

units.source_text: 这期间，我给九州的哥哥寄出了一封长信，妹妹那边是母亲写的信。

en.t: During that time, I sent a long letter to my elder brother in Kyushu, while Mother wrote to my younger sister.

units.source_text: 我心想，说不定这是写给他们的最后一封有关父亲病情的信了，

en.t: I thought to myself that this might perhaps be the last letter we would write to them about Father's condition,

units.source_text: 所以在给他们的信中都写了，一旦父亲病危，就给他们打电报，要他们到时候尽量赶回来。

en.t: so in both letters we wrote that if Father's condition became critical, we would send them a telegram and they should do their best to come home then.

units.source_text: 哥哥工作很忙，妹妹正怀着身孕。

en.t: My elder brother was very busy with work, and my younger sister was pregnant.

units.source_text: 所以，父亲的病不到最后关头，是不好轻易叫他们回来的。

en.t: Therefore, unless Father's illness reached its final stage, it would not be right to call them home lightly.

units.source_text: 虽说如此，倘若他们特意赶来，却没能见上父亲最后一面，落下埋怨也不好受。

en.t: Even so, if they made a special effort to come and still failed to see Father one last time, it would be painful to face their resentment.

units.source_text: 在该如何把握打电报的时机上，我深切感受到了旁人无法理解的责任。

en.t: I felt keenly a responsibility others could not understand over how to judge the timing for sending the telegram.

units.source_text: “这个我也很难说得那么准确，不过你要知道，危险随时都有可能的。”

en.t: “I cannot say that with such precision either, but you must understand that danger could come at any time.”

units.source_text: 从车站所在的那条街请来的医生对我这样说。

en.t: The doctor we had called from the town where the station was located said this to me.

units.source_text: 我同母亲商量后，决定托这位医生介绍，从镇医院请一位护士来。

en.t: After consulting with Mother, I decided to ask this doctor to arrange for a nurse from the town hospital.

units.source_text: 父亲看见一位穿白衣服的女人来到枕边，跟他说话，便露出诧异的神色。

en.t: When Father saw a woman in white come to his bedside and speak to him, he looked surprised.

units.source_text: 父亲早就知道自己患了不治之症，可是他并没有想到死亡已迫在眼前。

en.t: Father had long known that he was suffering from an incurable illness, but he had not imagined that death was already close at hand.

units.source_text: “等过些日子，我的病好了，还要去东京玩一次。

en.t: “When some time has passed and I have recovered, I want to go to Tokyo once more for a visit.

units.source_text: 人不知道自己什么时候死，所以想做的事，要趁活着的时候做。”

en.t: People never know when they will die, so the things they want to do should be done while they are alive.”

units.source_text: 母亲无可奈何地附和着说：“那时候也带我一起去吧。”

en.t: Mother, with no other choice, went along with him and said, “When that time comes, take me with you too.”
